description: This Dart source file defines the `NewsAppState` class, which manages the application state for a Flutter news app. It handles loading news data from a database, fetching categories from an API, error handling, and providing data to the UI components. The class also manages saved articles, refreshes categories, and falls back on mock data when network issues occur.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A state management class extending ChangeNotifier, responsible for managing news data, loading states, error messages, and user interactions such as saving and deleting articles. It initializes by fetching news categories and handles errors gracefully, providing mock data when needed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the application state by loading saved news and fetching news categories from the API. Handles connectivity issues by falling back to mock data if necessary.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns a list of news articles for a specific category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns a list of top headlines from the general category, limited to a predefined count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns all general category articles except the top headlines.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Fetches and updates news articles for a specific category, handling errors and optionally providing mock data.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches news articles for a category from the repository and updates internal state.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Loads mock news data for all categories, typically used during connectivity issues.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with a specific headline is saved locally.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves or updates an article in the local database and refreshes the saved articles list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article by its headline and updates the saved list.

methods.name: undoSaveByHeadline
methods.description: Reverses a save action by deleting the article by headline.
